Name: Marriageable Milkable Wumbus
Author: SiTheGreat1
Description:
praise be to wumbus

fully marriageable npc

no heart events, just vibes

attends the flower festival but no other festivals

likes hot pepper (in honor of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/44374]spicy krobus[/url]) and pizza

default saloon music will be the star wars cantina music, you can turn it off in the config

if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27100]BETAS[/url] installed, you can now milk wumbus by interacting while holding a milk pail (thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/43592]chocolatte12[/url] for inspiring this horror and helping me implement it). you'll get green milk, and it can be kegged. praise wumbus

wumbus accepts being all genders; he will use whatever she darn well pleases

[b]Art and Translations
[/b]Art replacements and translations are allowed as long as they [b]do not use AI[/b], and must require this mod as a dependency. Thank you! Praise Wumbus!

Downloads.Description: (see changelog) may the fourth be with you
